vent.name: Vent Shaft
vent.desc: Marks a straight shaft up to the surface for fresh air.

sump.name: Drainage Sump
sump.desc: Paints a small sump chamber that drains water.

seal.name: Clay Seal
seal.desc: A door: ants pass, water and air do not.

pillar.name: Support Pillar
pillar.desc: Fills an open cell with packed soil that stops collapses.

thatch.name: Thatch Dome
thatch.desc: Insulates the entrance and keeps rain out.
